name: Picture Garden
lore: A quiet garden at the start of the road: fruit, sweets, animals and old paintings, each one dug out a block at a time.

profile.note: World 1, casual: Kitten Forest’s casual profile (tools/land-01-notes.md §10.1) on 36 levels: about 13 Easy, 19 Normal, 4 lone Hards, ending on a Hard; light features (? cards, a few linked pairs and mystery blocks), no locks, no Extreme, generous random-tap bands, no lookahead or careful ceilings. The boards are the Gallery’s own (36 x 41 class, smaller than a land’s max phone board), so the pace aim is the Gallery’s side-quest aim, 200 s. v6 lane D8: no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08; hidden share 0).

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

add.note: v6 lane D15 (2026-10-08; Peter: 'bring picture garden up to an even 50', lane C's 14 AI full garden scenes, picks OKed by Peter): pictures 37-50 appended to World 1 (ids z1-37..z1-50), the 36 kept byte for byte. Sources: lane C's picks-full.json landManifest (pictures/manifest.json, 14 picks + 2 spares), kind painting, shaded, converted by tools/land.js boardOf (identical to lane C's boards-full/). Profile: World 1's, plus the careful floor 0.5 on every tag (v6 lane D5's rule for new Zen levels); no moats (World 1 has none), no mystery blocks, no locks, no Extreme. Tags (lane D's layout, a sawtooth after 36's Hard): E N N E N N H E N N E N N H, the finale 50 a gentle Hard (bands: its band the Hard band's top half, 13-20%). Order: no shared subject within 5 levels of each other or of 31-36 (tools/world-01-50-notes.md). Map: two more Kitten Forest sheets in World 1's turn and tint (A' then B), 7 levels each, eggs at the spurs' tips.
